item_name: Deluxe Star of Life Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Star of Life Low Profile Cap Is Lightweight And Resilient Making It The Perfect Addition To Your EMT Uniform.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Star of Life Low Profile Cap Is Lightweight And Resilient Making It The Perfect Addition To Your EMT Uniform.  This Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill and features an embroidered Star of Life Logo on the front panel. “EMT” embroidered white lettering is located on the left side of the brim and the center of the brim. The Deluxe Star of Life cap is both lightweight and resilient. Top ventilation holes and an internal sweatband offer superior comfort. The cap is ideal for EMS and EMT professionals.
